name: Creativity
overview: Scripture reveals that creativity originates with God, who in the beginning created the heavens and the earth and fashioned mankind in His own image, imparting a unique creative capacity to humanity. The Lord equips individuals with the Spirit, granting wisdom, understanding, and skill to perform various forms of workmanship, as demonstrated in the detailed craftsmanship described in Exodus. God's manifold works display His infinite wisdom and richness, setting the foundation for human creativity as a reflection of His divine nature.
